body.title: No-Show Calculator
body.excerpt: A missed appointment cost calculator: see what no-shows cost your business a year, how much reminders win back and how fast they pay for themselves.
body.content:
Every no-show is a paid slot that earns nothing. Put in your weekly bookings, your no-show rate and what an appointment is worth, and see the yearly cost, what reminders could win back and the plan that fits your team.

[Calculator goes here. Add a Custom HTML block and paste the calculator block from no-show-calculator.html, everything from calculator:start to calculator:end.]

How the no-show calculator works

  1. Appointments a year = appointments a week x weeks open.
  2. Missed appointments = appointments a year x your no-show rate.
  3. Revenue lost = missed appointments x average appointment value.
  4. Won back = revenue lost x (12 - 7) / 12, about 42%: the share of no-shows reminders removed across our customers (12% fell to 7%).
  5. Days to pay back = the plan's yearly cost / (won back / 365), rounded up.

How to work out your no-show rate

No-show rate = no-shows / appointments booked x 100. Example: 14 no-shows out of 120 bookings is 11.7%.

Worked example: a 3-person salon

A salon with 3 staff books 60 appointments a week, 48 weeks a year, at $55 each, and 12% don't show. That is 346 missed appointments and $19,008 a year. Reminders could win back $7,920, so the Growth plan ($588 a year) pays for itself in 28 days.

Where the reminder figure comes from

  • Reminder effect: Example Booking Software customer data, January to September 2026, businesses that turned on reminders (1,840 businesses), median no-show rate 12% before and 7% after. Your result may differ.
  • Revenue is before costs. A slot that gets rebooked late still counts as lost here, so the figure is an upper bound for very busy books.
  • Plan prices are the current monthly list prices; the calculator uses the smallest plan that covers your staff.

Questions

How do you calculate no-show rate?

Divide no-shows by appointments booked in the same period and multiply by 100. Use a full month so one quiet week doesn't skew it. The helper inside the calculator does this for you.

What is an acceptable no-show rate?

Compare yourself with businesses like yours rather than one industry figure. Across our customers the median was 12% before reminders and 7% after.

Do reminder texts reduce no-shows?

In our customer data, yes: the median no-show rate fell from 12% to 7% after reminders were turned on, which is why the calculator wins back 42% of the cost.

How much do no-shows cost a business?

Missed appointments a year times the average appointment value. The calculator works it out from your own numbers in a minute.
